content_sections.heading: IISER Pune ANRF Project Associate I Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IISER Pune Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IISER Pune ANRF Project Associate I Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: ANRF Project Associate I: Master’s degree in Chemistry or related areas. Candidates having experimental research experience in inorganic chemistry will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: ANRF Project Associate I: Maximum 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: ANRF Project Associate I: Rs. 30,000 + 30% House Rent Allowance (Rs. 37,000 + 30% HRA for candidates having valid CSIR-NET / GATE / DBT-JRF / any other National Level Test)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune ANRF Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is ANRF Project Associate-I at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the ANRF Project Associate-I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 22 October 2026 at the IISER Pune campus.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Chemistry or related areas to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the ANRF Project Associate-I post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 30,000 + 30% HRA, which increases to Rs. 37,000 + 30% HRA for candidates with valid NET/GATE/DBT-JRF qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Discussion Room No. 31, 2nd floor, IISER Pune Campus, Main Building.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a temporary research position under the ANRF project at IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry?
faq.answer: You should carry your original educational certificates, mark sheets, birth certificate, experience certificates, government-issued photo ID, and a recent passport-size photograph.
